reason: Pay-on-completion is clever and it does take away the money risk, but I've been burned once and I'm not handing my business's main shopfront to a company in Kuwait with no clients, no reviews and a site of its own that doesn't look finished. I'd rather ask the local Facebook group who they used and go with someone I can actually meet.
objection: Nobody can vouch for them. If it drags on or they disappear halfway, I've lost weeks of my time and I'm stuck chasing someone in another time zone, and £655 for a business my size makes me wonder what corners get cut.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing two or three finished sites for real UK businesses I could ring and ask, ideally a recommendation from someone in my local group.
